name: SLR Longarisse - Bayonne
description_md:
The SLR Longarisse to Bayonne route is a hard waymarked hiking route in France covering 252.4 km. It features 1470 m of ascent and 1477 m of descent, with an estimated walking time of about 67 hours based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This international waymarked hiking network trail follows a line that matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. Along the way, the path passes within 100 m of the Basque Museum in Bayonne, the Town Hall and Theatre of Bayonne, and Château-Vieux.
